# `<dirent.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Minimal opendir/readdir/closedir for tier-2 (newlib) programs.

newlib's own <dirent.h> refuses to build on this target, so this header shadows it. lib/posix/dirent.c implements it with FsdReadDir().

```c
#include <dirent.h>
```

## Types

| Type | Definition | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="dir"></a>`DIR` | `struct DIR` | An open directory; opaque. |

## Structures

### `dirent` { #dirent }

One directory entry.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `d_type` | `unsigned char` | An [FsdFileType](fs/protocols/fsd.md#fsdfiletype). |
| `d_name` | `char` | NUL-terminated name, as in [FsdDirEntry](fs/protocols/fsd.md#fsddirentry). |

## Functions

### `opendir` { #opendir }

```c
DIR * opendir(const char *path);
```

Opens a directory for reading.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | in | Directory path. |

**Returns:** The directory, or NULL with errno set.

### `readdir` { #readdir }

```c
struct dirent * readdir(DIR *dirp);
```

Returns the next entry.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dirp` | inout | Directory from opendir(). |

**Returns:** The entry, valid until the next call, or NULL at the end.

### `closedir` { #closedir }

```c
int closedir(DIR *dirp);
```

Closes a directory.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dirp` | in | Directory from opendir(). |

**Returns:** 0.
